items.title: Quiet Reader
items.summary: An AI reading companion that gives second-language readers spoiler-safe vocabulary previews before each chapter. Live in the browser, no install needed.
bullets: Designed a 3-agent LLM workflow (profiler, chapter parser, spoiler-safe context generator), processing 47 chapters across 4 books.
Added guardrails (schema validation, automatic retries, spoiler checks) so every model output stays structured and usable.
Released it open source, then deployed the frontend on Vercel and the backend on Railway so anyone can try it.

items.title: Retail Program Impact
items.summary: Do retail programs actually lift new-product sales? A store-level analysis for a grocery wholesaler.
bullets: Joined store, product, program, and sales tables in SQL into one validated store-level dataset.
Used regression with interaction terms in Python to see how program effects differed by brand, division, and category.
Recommended selective, category-specific deployment with a pilot, and presented it to the client.

items.title: Dynamic Electricity Pricing
items.summary: A day-ahead load forecast (MAPE 2.73%) and a bounded pricing rule that cut simulated peak demand 12.5%.
bullets: Cleaned and merged 25,990 hourly records of grid load, weather, and day-ahead prices.
Built a 24-hour-ahead XGBoost forecast with a strict time-based train/test split.
Simulated a three-tier pricing rule: peak demand down 12.5% vs. flat rate, bills down 11.7% vs. time-of-use. Presented at SIEDS.

items.title: USDT Systemic Risk Monitor
items.summary: A Dune dashboard over millions of Ethereum logs, finding whale trades often exceed 80% of daily volume.
bullets: Defined 4 risk KPIs for Tether, including pool imbalance and trade slippage in basis points.
Built the dashboard in SQL with CTEs and window functions.
Segmented volume by trade size, challenging the assumption that flows are retail-driven.
